seoDescription: Emerald Jhumka blouse with gold Aari ovals, beadwork and tassels. Pair with green, gold or contrasting silk sarees. Listed at ₹4,999; timing by enquiry.
seoCopy: Emerald Jhumka Elegance pairs an emerald-green base with repeated gold oval motifs, embellished sleeve cuffs and jhumka-style tassels at the back. The listed work combines Aari-style gold embroidery, beadwork and decorative tassels; the page does not claim a particular bead alloy or thread fibre. The rounded neckline and repeated oval borders give the front a clear focal point, while the U-shaped back and tassels carry the motif through to the reverse. Emerald, bottle green, red, cream and gold sarees are possible pairings, depending on the saree border, pallu and jewellery. Bring a daylight photo or the saree itself so colours can be considered together rather than matched from a screen. The listed starting price is ₹4,999 for hand embroidery on a customer-supplied blouse or garment; the garment, courier and additional material changes are separate. No fixed crafting duration is promised here. Share your event date and garment readiness, and the studio will confirm a realistic timeline after reviewing the final work and current schedule.
summary: An emerald green blouse with ornate gold oval borders, scattered motifs and traditional jhumka-style back tassels.
description: The front showcases a rounded neckline framed by repeated gold oval motifs, with matching embellished sleeve cuffs and a coordinated lower border. The back features a wide U-shaped neckline, scalloped oval embroidery, tie strings and paired jhumka-style tassels. The rich green-and-gold palette gives the design a traditional festive and bridal feel.
